# couchbase-capella_app_service_audit_log_export_jobs (Data Source)

The data source to retrieve the audit log export jobs of an App Service, optionally filtered by export ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella_app_service_audit_log_export_jobs" "app_service_audit_log_export_jobs" {
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
  project_id      = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id      = "<cluster_id>"
  app_service_id  = "<app_service_id>"

  # Optional. Omit to return every export job of the App Service.
  export_id = "<export_id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Optional

- `export_id` (String) The ID of an export job. When set, only the export job with this ID is returned. When omitted, all export jobs are returned.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) The audit log export jobs of the App Service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--audit))
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `download_expires` (String) The RFC3339 timestamp at which the download expires.
- `download_id` (String) The ID used to download the exported audit logs.
- `id` (String) The ID of the audit log export job.
- `status` (String) The status of the export job.
- `tenant_id` (String) The ID of the tenant (organization) that owns the export job.
